invariants.rationale: The method requires a non-null config to function, as config.getBasePath() and other calls are made unguarded.
The method immediately calls context.getStorageConf(), so context must be non-null.
config.getBasePath() is passed to setBasePath(), which likely requires a valid non-null value.
config.getConsistencyGuardConfig() is required to build the metaClient, so should be non-null.
config.getTimeGeneratorConfig() is required as an argument in the builder.
